title: What is Amazon FBA? A Beginner's Guide to Selling in 2026
content:
If you want to start an online store but hate the idea of packing boxes, keeping inventory in your bedroom, and dealing with post offices, Amazon FBA is the solution.

FBA stands for Fulfillment by Amazon. It is a service where Amazon handles all the heavy lifting for your e-commerce business.

How Amazon FBA Works in 4 Steps

  1. Send Your Products to Amazon: You buy inventory and ship it directly to an Amazon fulfillment center.
  2. Amazon Stores Your Items: They look after your stock in their massive warehouses.
  3. Customers Buy Your Product: When someone places an order on Amazon, Amazon picks and packs the item.
  4. Amazon Ships & Handles Service: They ship it out with fast Prime delivery and handle any returns or customer issues.

The Major Benefits

  • Instant Prime Badge: Your products automatically get free 1-2 day Prime shipping, making customers much more likely to buy.
  • Hands-Off Scaling: You can sell thousands of items a day without lifting a finger to ship them.
  • Trust: Customers trust Amazon's quick shipping and return policy.

The Catch: FBA Fees

Amazon doesn't do this for free. They charge storage fees (based on size and time) and fulfillment fees (per item shipped). To succeed, you must calculate these fees into your pricing strategy before buying inventory.
